First version of TokenScope.

**Download** `TokenScope-Setup-1.0.0.exe` below and run it. It installs for your Windows user only, with no admin rights needed, and starts TokenScope when done.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**What's in it**
- **Models:** current prices for every model on OpenRouter, with sorting, filters and favorites.
- **Plans:** your AI estimates a task before it starts, and TokenScope measures what it really cost (exact in Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, approximate in Cursor).
- **Spending:** what every conversation cost and why, filterable by tool and model maker, with what it would have cost on other models. Your AI can read it and suggest how to spend less.

**Getting started:** open Settings & help, press Set up next to the tool you use your AI in, and turn your tools on under Track AI spending.
